results.title: AngloGold Ashanti, Endeavour Mining host maiden West Africa mine rescue competition
results.content: AngloGold Ashanti's Obuasi Mine and Endeavour Mining have jointly hosted the maiden edition of the West Africa Mine Rescue and Emergency Response Competition (WAMRERC 2026), bringing together emergency response teams from four countries to test their preparedness for mining-related incidents. The five-day competition, held at the Obuasi Mine, involves teams from Ghana, Burkina Faso, Côte d’Ivoire and Senegal. It is aimed at assessing their technical capabilities, encouraging the exchange of knowledge and strengthening cooperation in emergency response across the West African mining industry. Held under the theme, “Together, Saving Lives Through Preparedness and Excellence,” the event is expected to provide a platform for mine rescue professionals to share expertise and build a regional network that can support coordinated responses to emergencies.
